description: Which lakes could be trusted in a controlled beta. Separate from Brain scores (never averaged). Hard blockers → NOT_READY; warnings → CANDIDATE; neither → READY. Every item traces to a published Brain fact. Frozen 2026-10-12.

hardBlockers.when: a required slot has no published state for the lake
a required slot's state is stale (Engine time rule, slots.stale)
the slot's owning brain has not published within its staleAfterHours (control.brains[id].stale)
a required slot's brain reports evidenceStale
a required slot's kind is unavailable
a required slot's readiness is below CALIBRATION on the ladder
no normalized Sector Intelligence evaluation exists for the lake
a required brain's health is FAILED

warnings.when: a required slot's readiness is below VALIDATED
the last Intelligence evaluation saw a degraded input
species-v2 knowledge median over present species < 5.0
no species presence for the lake
a required brain's validation is NOT_VALIDATED/absent
an owning source is past its stale threshold
